Name: Srikant Srinivasan
Bio: Prof Srikant Srinivasan is Dean of Academics and a Professor at Plaksha University. Before joining Plaksha, he was an Associate Professor and Associate Dean (Courses) at IIT Mandi. He also held research and teaching positions at Iowa State University, including work in materials informatics and high-throughput plant phenotyping. He earned a PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering from Purdue University.
Education: PhD, Purdue University | MS, Electrical & Computer Engineering, University of Cincinnati, USA | BTech, Electronics & Communications Engineering, VNR-VJIET, JNTU, Hyderabad
Research_Summary:
Prof Srinivasan's research spans computing and electrical engineering, with work in precision agriculture, advanced nanoelectronics, and beyond-CMOS computing. His work on nanomagnet-based computing explored alternatives to traditional silicon transistors.

Areas of work:

Precision agriculture

Computer vision and machine learning

IoT systems

Nanoelectronics and beyond-CMOS devices
Research_Interests: Precision Agriculture | Computer Vision | Machine Learning | Beyond-CMOS devices | IoT Systems | Nanoelectronics
